name: PinnerPress – Customizable Pinner Buttons for Pinterest Creators
author: PinnerPress

sections.description:
Customizable Pinner Buttons for Pinterest Creators makes it easy to add Pinterest Pin It buttons to your WordPress images, helping your visitors share your content on Pinterest and drive more traffic to your site.

Key Features:

  • Customizable Pin Buttons – Add stylish Pin It buttons to all your images
  • Multiple Button Styles – Choose from different button positions, shapes, and sizes
  • Custom Colors – Match your brand with custom button colors
  • Rich Pins Support – Enable or disable Pinterest Rich Pins
  • Per-Post Control – Disable pin buttons on specific posts/pages
  • Mobile Responsive – Works perfectly on all devices

How It Works:

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to Customizable Pinner Buttons settings in your WordPress admin
  3. Customize your pin button appearance
  4. Pin buttons will automatically appear on your images

The plugin automatically adds pin buttons to images in your content, making it easy for visitors to share your images on Pinterest with proper attribution back to your site.

Privacy & External Services:

This plugin opens URLs on pinterest.com when users click the pin buttons. By using this plugin, you acknowledge that Pinterest’s privacy policy and terms of service apply to the Pinterest sharing functionality:

  • Pinterest Privacy Policy: https://policy.pinterest.com/en/privacy-policy
  • Pinterest Terms of Service: https://policy.pinterest.com/en/terms-of-service
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/customizable-pinner-buttons-for-pinterest-creators directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the Customizable Pinner Buttons settings page to configure the plugin
sections.faq:
How do I customize the pin button appearance?

Go to Customizable Pinner Buttons > Settings in your WordPress admin. You can customize the button position, shape, size, colors, and text.

Can I disable pin buttons on specific posts?

Yes! When editing a post or page, you’ll see a Customizable Pinner Buttons meta box in the sidebar where you can disable pin buttons for that specific content.

Do the pin buttons work on mobile devices?

Yes, the pin buttons are fully responsive and work on all devices.

Can I change the button text?

Yes, you can customize the button text in the plugin settings.
